# Rerivo Typing Speed Test

> Rerivo is a free, no-signup online typing speed test and keyboard practice tool. Measure your typing speed in WPM (words per minute), track accuracy, and practice touch typing with a built-in virtual keyboard, on-screen hand/finger guide, multiple timed modes (15s–10min), and several text sets. Works in the browser on desktop and mobile, available in 5 languages, with dark/light/ocean themes.

## Core Tool
- [Typing Speed Test (home)](https://typing.rerivo.com/): Main 60-second WPM typing speed test with live WPM, accuracy, and error tracking.
- [Online Typing Test](https://typing.rerivo.com/online-typing-test.html): Browser-based typing test, no download or signup required.
- [Free Typing Test](https://typing.rerivo.com/free-typing-test.html): Completely free typing speed and accuracy test.
- [Typing Practice](https://typing.rerivo.com/typing-practice.html): Open-ended practice mode with virtual keyboard and finger guide.

## Timed Modes
- [1 Minute Typing Test](https://typing.rerivo.com/1-minute-typing-test.html): Classic 60-second WPM test.
- [2 Minute Typing Test](https://typing.rerivo.com/2-minute-typing-test.html): 2-minute endurance typing test.
- [5 Minute Typing Test](https://typing.rerivo.com/5-minute-typing-test.html): 5-minute test for sustained speed and stamina.
- [30 Second Typing Test](https://typing.rerivo.com/30-second-typing-test.html): Quick 30-second WPM snapshot.
- [3 Minute Typing Test](https://typing.rerivo.com/3-minute-typing-test.html): Balanced 3-minute test, a common pre-employment typing check length.
- [10 Minute Typing Test](https://typing.rerivo.com/10-minute-typing-test.html): 10-minute endurance test for sustained speed.

## Metrics & Scoring
- [Words Per Minute Test](https://typing.rerivo.com/words-per-minute-test.html): Explains and measures WPM.
- [WPM Test Online](https://typing.rerivo.com/wpm-test-online.html): Quick online WPM check.
- [Typing Accuracy Test](https://typing.rerivo.com/typing-accuracy-test.html): Focuses on accuracy and error rate.

## Text / Difficulty Variations
- [Number Typing Test](https://typing.rerivo.com/number-typing-test.html): Numeric keypad and digits practice.
- [English Typing Test](https://typing.rerivo.com/english-typing-test.html): Common English words and sentences.
- [Keyboard Typing Test](https://typing.rerivo.com/keyboard-typing-test.html): Full-keyboard touch typing with on-screen key highlighting.
- [Capital Letter Typing Test](https://typing.rerivo.com/capital-letter-typing-test.html): Uppercase and shift-key practice.
- [Punctuation Typing Test](https://typing.rerivo.com/punctuation-typing-test.html): Punctuation and symbol accuracy.
- [Easy Typing Test](https://typing.rerivo.com/easy-typing-test.html): Beginner-friendly simple words.
- [Typing Test Game](https://typing.rerivo.com/typing-test-game.html): Gamified typing challenge.
- [Typing Games](https://typing.rerivo.com/typing-games.html): Fun, gamified typing challenges and races.
- [Typing Lessons](https://typing.rerivo.com/typing-lessons.html): Step-by-step free touch typing lessons and course.

## About
- Free, no registration, privacy-friendly (runs fully in the browser).
- Features: live WPM/CPM, accuracy %, error highlighting, adjustable virtual keyboard with next-key highlight, on-screen hands finger guide, 5 languages, 3 color themes.
- Sitemap: https://typing.rerivo.com/sitemap.xml
